title: From trading desks to brunch kitchens: Claude's 26 receipts
dek: 26 Claude use cases from Anthropic's S-1, the measured gains, and the evidence that cuts the other way.
blurb: Anthropic's IPO filing shows Claude inside 26 organisations, from AIG's underwriters to a Boston brunch kitchen. What it saved, where the gains are biggest, and what the numbers can't tell you.

title: Popped or leaking? The AI bubble in October 2026
